label: Giovanni Antonio Boltraffio
summary: Milanese painter of patrician family, active in Leonardo's circle from about 1490.

claims.statement: Born about 1466 to 1467 (from his age at death on his epitaph).

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Died in Milan on 15 June 1516; epitaph formerly in San Paolo in Compito.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Identified with the 'Gian Antonio' of the Salai theft notes of 1491.

sources.cite: Standard literature. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Vasari names him as Leonardo's pupil ('creato'); stylistic dependence supports this. A pupil relation is an interpretation of the sources.
